event.selection_basis: PG&E's CPUC-hosted post-event report states it began de-energizing at 2021-08-17 17:00 PDT, identifies Shasta among counties with de-energized time-places, and reports a Shasta weather-station maximum gust. This is planned de-energization evidence only.
exclusions: No complete county six-hour weather series has been collected.
uncertainties: The report-wide 17:00 PDT start is not a Shasta-specific activation; Appendix B lists individual Shasta circuit starts later that evening.
The reported maximum gust is a county-scope station summary, not a complete six-hour county weather series.
The utility report is not independent verification of wildfire causation, fire occurrence, or a county outage label.
